run_video_pose_propagation: run the video pose propagation script with a json_dir and preds_dir argument to propagate keypoints across frames
propagate_keypoints_across_frames: propagate ground truth keypoint predictions across consecutive video frames using temporal delta offsets
build_propagated_gt_predictions: build propagated ground truth predictions and bounding boxes from delta-shifted H5 prediction files
parse_posetrack_annotations: parse the posetrack_val_consecutive.json file to extract valid image annotations and frame sequences
save_propagated_predictions: save propagated keypoint predictions and bounding boxes as H5 files with a filenames map
